science.title: Madhya Pradesh’s Pichore granite is 2.5 billion years old, shows study; among the oldest geological formations on Earth
science.description: A new study by an international team of geologists has shed light on a rare and visually stunning rock formation in central India that serves as a high-resolution time capsule of our planet’s infancy. The research, focused on a tiny outcrop near the village of Kutawali in the Madhya Pradesh district, has confirmed that the Pichhore orbicular granite is approximately 2.56 billion years old. This makes it the second-oldest known example of its kind in the world, surpassed only by a similar formation in Western Australia.  | Pichhore site,Banaras Hindu University,University of Campinas–UNICAMP,IIT Kanpur,Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology,IISER Berhampur,AllGeo Solutions Pvt.Ltd,Kutawali
